apis.name: RAWG Video Games Database
apis.why_notable: Largest video game metadata API with 500k+ games, screenshots, stores, and discovery endpoints.

apis.name: IGDB API
apis.why_notable: Twitch-backed industry-standard game database with rich metadata, covers, and GraphQL/Apicalypse queries.

apis.name: Giant Bomb API
apis.why_notable: Long-running game/wiki API with characters, companies, reviews, and franchise data from CBS Interactive.

apis.name: SteamSpy API
apis.why_notable: Steam ownership and sales estimates by app ID; widely used for market research despite limited docs.

apis.name: IsThereAnyDeal API
apis.why_notable: Cross-store game price history, deals, and waitlists across dozens of PC digital storefronts.

apis.name: PriceCharting API
apis.why_notable: Video game, console, and trading-card market prices with graded/ungraded variants.

apis.name: PokéAPI
apis.why_notable: Canonical free RESTful Pokémon species, moves, types, and sprite data—no key required.

apis.name: Magic: The Gathering API
apis.why_notable: Community MTG card catalog with sets, types, and multiverse IDs (complement to Scryfall).

apis.name: TCGplayer API
apis.why_notable: Major TCG marketplace product catalog and market pricing for Magic, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and more.

apis.name: Marvel Comics API
apis.why_notable: Official Marvel comics, characters, creators, events, and series catalog with image assets.

apis.name: Anilist GraphQL API
apis.why_notable: Anime/manga tracking GraphQL API with media, characters, studios, and user lists—key for comics-adjacent media.

apis.name: Jikan API
apis.why_notable: Unofficial MyAnimeList REST wrapper for anime, manga, characters, and seasonal schedules.

apis.name: OpenTDB
apis.why_notable: Open Trivia Database with video-game and entertainment quiz categories; no auth for basic use.

apis.name: RAWG-alternative: Games Database via MobyGames API
apis.why_notable: Deep historical game catalog with platforms, covers, credits, and company relationships.

apis.name: Board Game Atlas API
apis.why_notable: Board game search, prices, and Kickstarter data as a modern complement to BoardGameGeek.

apis.name: Steam Grid DB API
apis.why_notable: Community artwork API for game grids, heroes, logos, and icons used by launchers and skins.

apis.name: HowLongToBeat API (via HLTB unofficial)
apis.why_notable: Game completion-time estimates scraped/wrapped by community libraries for backlog tooling.

apis.name: Xbox Live / OpenXBL
apis.why_notable: Self-serve Xbox Live profile, presence, achievements, and friends API for third-party apps.

apis.name: PlayerDB
apis.why_notable: Cross-game player ID lookup for Minecraft, Steam, Xbox, and other platforms in one API.

apis.name: Fortnite-API
apis.why_notable: Unofficial Fortnite cosmetics, shop, stats, and news endpoints popular with bot/discord tools.

apis.name: Valorant-API
apis.why_notable: Community Valorant agents, weapons, maps, and content bundles without Riot key for static data.

apis.name: PokeAPI (duplicate check skip) - instead AmiiboAPI
apis.why_notable: Nintendo Amiibo figure catalog with games, series, and character cross-references.

apis.name: D&D 5e API
apis.why_notable: Open SRD REST API for D&D 5e monsters, spells, classes, and equipment for tabletop apps.

apis.name: Open5e
apis.why_notable: Expanded 5e open-content API including monsters, spells, and third-party SRD material.

apis.name: GeekDo / BoardGameGeek already excluded - use Ludopedia
apis.why_notable: Brazilian board-game community API with ratings, collections, and regional catalog data.
